name: goragod/filebridge
description: Two-panel web console for copying files between servers over SFTP, FTP and FTPS. Plain PHP, vanilla JavaScript, no build step.

suggest.ext-ssh2: Faster SFTP backend (libssh2). Without it the pure PHP phpseclib backend is used.
suggest.ext-ftp: Required for the FTP and FTPS connections.
suggest.ext-zip: Required to download folders and multi-file selections as a zip archive.
